program.name: Ladder and Pairs
program.subject: Pull-ups
program.blurb: A pull-up ladder first, then full-body supersets.
program.about: Pull-ups while you are fresh, then the rest of the body. Each day opens with a pull-up ladder, one rep, then two, then three, as high as you can go, then supersets of a press, a row and the legs. Two days alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III slows the lowering to three seconds.
program.split: Pull-up ladder, then supersets, A / B
